question: Under the clause “the owner contributes 3 million yuan for the fit-out / the operator contributes a 1 million yuan performance deposit / 65:35 revenue share”, should we take on the brand operation of this apartment project?

options.name: Sign under the current clause
options.rationale: Locks in the project immediately, but the operator's unit economics are structurally negative

options.name: Run a clause stress test first, renegotiate the revenue-share structure, then sign
options.rationale: Trades a few weeks for certainty on the terms

options.name: Walk away from the project
options.rationale: Avoids all the investment, but gives up a market opportunity that has already been identified

chosen_option: Run a clause stress test first, renegotiate the revenue-share structure, then sign

rejected_options.name: Sign under the current clause
rejected_options.reason: The operator's monthly cash flow is -44,523 yuan and the deposit burns through in 22 months; signing locks in a contract under which the operator makes a cumulative loss over 8 years

rejected_options.name: Walk away from the project
rejected_options.reason: The evidence does not support “not taking it on”; the two P0 compliance checks are incomplete — the channel may not exist at all, or it may be entirely lawful

tradeoffs: Giving up the chance to lock in the project immediately
Bearing the time cost of the owner turning to another operator
key_assumptions: The operator will accept the 65:35 revenue-share structure
falsification_conditions: If the owner insists on 65:35, the operator will inevitably refuse to sign, or default and exit after signing
If measured steady-state occupancy on the same street is below 88%, every payback calculation flips
validation_actions: Put the current clause and the back-solved feasible range in front of both parties at the same time, and run a clause stress test
